description: Resolves a symbol name (e.g. "UserRepository.getUser", "users::repository::get") via the language server's workspace/symbol API and returns just the symbol body. Use this when you need a function or class definition but not the rest of the file. Falls back to no-match when the LSP can't resolve the symbol. Detected frameworks: none

contextLines.description: Lines of context to include before + after each symbol body

includeImports.description: Prepend leading imports / package / use lines from the file

maxMatches.description: Cap on number of symbol matches returned (default 5)

query.description: Symbol name, optionally container-qualified (Foo.bar / Foo::bar / Foo#bar)

name: read_symbol
title: Read a symbol body via LSP (no whole-file read)
